'''David Forbes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Austin tournament (23 June)]] on 23 June 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2529">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-austin-tx-6-23-01d2529/ austin-tx-6-23-01], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 26 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-austin-tx-6-23-01d2529/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
